productOnPage.title: The Pet Sitters Dress-Ups Collection
productOnPage.author: Ella Shine
productOnPage.description: Two best friends. One talking cat. Dress-up costumes for everyone. What could possibly go wrong? Join Cassie and Lina in four more hilarious pet sitting adventures with the magical animals of Barefoot Springs! Cassie and Lina and their grumpy talking cat Gus are back pet sitting more animals in Barefoot Springs, this time in costume. Have the best friends got what it takes to pet sit multiplying mice, a dancing goat, a pirate-loving parrot and a disappearing bulldog?! Find out in the second hilarious collection of stories about the Barefoot Springs Pet Sitters. The Dress-Ups Collection includes four original stories: Train Trouble, Billy Goat Boogie, Pirate Problems and Dress Up Disaster. Tracks included: Train Trouble Intro Dedication Chapter 01 - An Exciting Day Chapter 02 - Gus in Love Chapter 03 - Dress Ups Chapter 04 - More Mice Chapter 05 - A Close Call Chapter 06 - Gus Tries To Help Chapter 07 - Hiding Mice Chapter 08 - No Mice Here Chapter 09 - Oh No, Gus Chapter 10 - Safe And Happy Lina and Cassie's Very Important and Useful Pet Sitting Tips Outro Billy Goat Boogie Intro Dedication Chapter 01 - Waiting for Winton Chapter 02 - Winton's Surprise Chapter 03 - Not Just Hip-Hop Chapter 04 - Stop Dancing, Winton Chapter 05 - Time To Dress Up Chapter 06 - Gus Gets Bored Chapter 07 - No, Gus, No! Chapter 08 - Cha-Cha Chaos Chapter 09 - That Cat! Chapter 10 - Gus Is A Star Lina and Cassie's Very Important and Useful Pet Sitting Tips Outro Pirate Problems Intro Dedication Chapter 01 - No Mumble-Grumble! Chapter 02 - A Pirate's Pet Chapter 03 - Cats Can't Climb the Rigging Chapter 04 - Interview Practice Chapter 05 - Talking Like A Pirate? Chapter 06 - Pirate Problems Chapter 07 - Mutiny! Chapter 08 - Chasing Trixie Chapter 09 - The Interview Chapter 10 - Captain Gus Lina and Cassie's Very Important and Useful Pet Sitting Tips Outro Dress Up Disaster Intro Dedication Chapter 01 - Gus Isn't Sure Chapter 02 - Hello, Patti! Chapter 03 - Turbans and Tutus Chapter 04 - Gus Says No, Patti Says Woof Chapter 05 - Show Much Fun Chapter 06 - Come Back Gus Chapter 07 - Roly Poly Gus Chapter 08 - Undignified Disaster Chapter 09 - Matching After All Chapter 10 - Four Bulldogs Lina and Cassie's Very Important and Useful Pet Sitting Tips Outro
